theorem putnam_1964_b2

(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by 
  
  
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    have h₁ : A ∉ P := h.1
    have h₂ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h.2
    
    have h₃ : ∃ (U : Set S), U ∈ P ∧ A ∩ U = ∅ := by
      have h₄ : ¬(A ∉ P ∧ ∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → A ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
        intro h₅
        have h₆ : ∃ (T : Set S), T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          refine' ⟨A, _⟩
          constructor
          · exact h₅.1
          · intro U hU
            have h₇ := h₅.2 U hU
            
            have h₉ : A ∩ U = U ∩ A := by
              ext x
              simp only [mem_inter_iff]
              <;> tauto
            have h₁₀ : U ∩ A ≠ ∅ := by
              intro h₁₁
              apply h₇
              simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, not_true_eq_false]
              
            simpa [Set.inter_comm] using h₁₀
        exact hPS h₆
      by_cases h₅ : A ∉ P
      · have h₆ : ¬(∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → A ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          intro h₇
          exact h₄ ⟨h₅, h₇⟩
        push_neg at h₆
        obtain ⟨U, hU, h₈⟩ := h₆
        refine' ⟨U, hU, _⟩
        by_contra h₁₀
        have h₁₁ : A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := h₁₀
        simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
  not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, true_and]
      · exfalso
        simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self]

    obtain ⟨U, hU, hU'⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hV'⟩ := h₄
    
    have h₅ : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₆
      have h₇ : x ∈ A := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₈ : x ∈ A ∩ U := Set.mem_inter h₇ hx
      rw [hU'] at h₈
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₈
      
    have h₆ : V ⊆ A := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₇
      have h₈ : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₉ : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := Set.mem_inter h₈ hx
      rw [hV'] at h₉
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₉
      
    
    have h₇ : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      have h₈ : x ∈ U := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_left hx
      have h₉ : x ∈ V := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right hx
      have h₁₀ : x ∈ Aᶜ := h₅ h₈
      have h₁₁ : x ∈ A := h₆ h₉
      simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_inter_iff,
    mem_compl_iff, not_true_eq_false]
      
    
    have h₈ : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
    simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
    
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra h

    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ h

      intro A hA
      
      have h₅ : A ∉ P := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA
        tauto
      
      have h₇ : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := h_subset_or_compl A

      | inl h₈ =>

        tauto
      | inr h₈ =>

    have h₆ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := h₂

        intro A hA hA'
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA'
        tauto
      have h₅ : P ∪ Q = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro A
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Q]
        <;>
        by_cases h₆ : A ∈ P <;> simp_all [h_subset_or_compl]
        
        
      have h₆ : P.card + Q.card = (P ∪ Q).card := by
        rw [← Finset.card_union_add_card_inter P Q]
        have h₇ : P ∩ Q = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h₄
        rw [h₇]
        simp only [Finset.card_empty, add_zero]
      rw [h₅] at h₆
      exact h₆
    have h₄ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
      
      
      
      
      
    linarith
  
  have h₃ : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    
    have h₅ : P.card = Q.card := h₁
    linarith
  
  have h₄ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    
    have h₆ : 0 < Fintype.card S := by
      apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
      exact ⟨Classical.choice inferInstance⟩
    omega
  have h₆ : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := h₃
  have h₇ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := h₄
  have h₈ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₉ : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
      have h₁₀ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := h₄
      omega
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
        rw [h₉]
        
  
  
  nlinarith

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))

(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))

  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by

    have h₁ : A ∉ P := h.1
    have h₂ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h.2
    
    have h₃ : ∃ (U : Set S), U ∈ P ∧ A ∩ U = ∅ := by grind
    
    have h₄ : ∃ (V : Set S), V ∈ P ∧ Aᶜ ∩ V = ∅ := by simp_all
    
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hU'⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hV'⟩ := h₄
    
    have h₅ : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₆
      have h₇ : x ∈ A := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₈ : x ∈ A ∩ U := Set.mem_inter h₇ hx
      rw [hU'] at h₈
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₈
      
    have h₆ : V ⊆ A := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₇
      have h₈ : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₉ : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := Set.mem_inter h₈ hx
      rw [hV'] at h₉
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₉
      
    
    have h₇ : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      have h₈ : x ∈ U := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_left hx
      have h₉ : x ∈ V := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right hx
      have h₁₀ : x ∈ Aᶜ := h₅ h₈
      have h₁₁ : x ∈ A := h₆ h₉
      simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_inter_iff,
    mem_compl_iff, not_true_eq_false]
      
    
    have h₈ : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
    simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
    
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra h
    
    have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by
      ext x

    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ h
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    contradiction
  
  classical
  
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
  
  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    
    have h₂ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by

      have h₄ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h_not_both A hA
      simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at *
      tauto
    have h₃ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by
      intro A hA
      
      have h₅ : A ∉ P := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA
        tauto
      
      have h₇ : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := h_subset_or_compl A
      cases h₇ with
      | inl h₈ =>
        exfalso
        tauto
      | inr h₈ =>
        exact h₈
    
    have h₆ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := h₂
    have h₇ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := h₃
    
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp_all [Set.ext_iff]
  
  have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₃ : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      have h₄ : Disjoint P Q := by
        rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
        intro A hA hA'
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA'
        tauto
      have h₅ : P ∪ Q = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro A
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Q]
        <;>
        by_cases h₆ : A ∈ P <;> simp_all [h_subset_or_compl]
        
        
      have h₆ : P.card + Q.card = (P ∪ Q).card := by
        rw [← Finset.card_union_add_card_inter P Q]
        have h₇ : P ∩ Q = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h₄
        rw [h₇]
        simp only [Finset.card_empty, add_zero]
      rw [h₅] at h₆
      exact h₆
    have h₄ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
      
      
      
      
      
    linarith

    have h₅ : P.card = Q.card := h₁
    linarith
  
  have h₄ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    
    have h₆ : 0 < Fintype.card S := by
      apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
      exact ⟨Classical.choice inferInstance⟩
    omega
  have h₆ : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := h₃
  have h₇ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := h₄
  have h₈ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₉ : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
      have h₁₀ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := h₄
      omega
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
        rw [h₉]
        
  
  
  nlinarith

proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by 
  
  
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    have h₁ : A ∉ P := h.1
    have h₂ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h.2
    
    have h₃ : ∃ (U : Set S), U ∈ P ∧ A ∩ U = ∅ := by grind
    
    have h₄ : ∃ (V : Set S), V ∈ P ∧ Aᶜ ∩ V = ∅ := by grind
    
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hU'⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hV'⟩ := h₄
    
    have h₅ : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₆
      have h₇ : x ∈ A := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₈ : x ∈ A ∩ U := Set.mem_inter h₇ hx
      rw [hU'] at h₈
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₈
      
    have h₆ : V ⊆ A := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₇
      have h₈ : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₉ : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := Set.mem_inter h₈ hx
      rw [hV'] at h₉
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₉
      
    
    have h₇ : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      have h₈ : x ∈ U := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_left hx
      have h₉ : x ∈ V := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right hx
      have h₁₀ : x ∈ Aᶜ := h₅ h₈
      have h₁₁ : x ∈ A := h₆ h₉
      simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_inter_iff,
    mem_compl_iff, not_true_eq_false]
      
    
    have h₈ : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
    simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
    
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra h
    
    have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp only [inter_compl_self, mem_empty_iff_false]
      
    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ h
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    contradiction
  
  classical
  
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
  
  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    
    have h₂ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
      intro A hA
      have h₃ : Aᶜ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := Finset.mem_univ _
      have h₄ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h_not_both A hA
      simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at *
      tauto
    have h₃ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by
      intro A hA
      
      have h₅ : A ∉ P := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA
        tauto
      
      have h₇ : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := h_subset_or_compl A
      cases h₇ with
      | inl h₈ =>
        exfalso
        tauto
      | inr h₈ =>
        exact h₈
    
    have h₆ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := h₂
    have h₇ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := h₃
    
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp_all [Set.ext_iff]
  
  have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₃ : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      have h₄ : Disjoint P Q := by
        rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
        intro A hA hA'
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA'
        tauto
      have h₅ : P ∪ Q = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by
        apply Finset.ext
        intro A
        grind
        <;>
        by_cases h₆ : A ∈ P <;> simp_all [h_subset_or_compl]
        
        
      have h₆ : P.card + Q.card = (P ∪ Q).card := by
        rw [← Finset.card_union_add_card_inter P Q]
        have h₇ : P ∩ Q = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h₄
        rw [h₇]
        simp only [Finset.card_empty, add_zero]
      rw [h₅] at h₆
      exact h₆
    have h₄ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
      
      
      
      
      
    linarith
  
  have h₃ : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    
    have h₅ : P.card = Q.card := h₁
    linarith
  
  have h₄ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    
    have h₆ : 0 < Fintype.card S := by
      apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
      exact ⟨Classical.choice inferInstance⟩
    omega
  have h₆ : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := h₃
  have h₇ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := h₄
  have h₈ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₉ : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
      have h₁₀ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := h₄
      omega
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
        rw [h₉]

    have h₇ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := h₃

    <;> simp_all [Set.ext_iff]

        apply Finset.ext
